title: Coventry partners come together to tackle child poverty
summary:
Every child deserves the chance to thrive. 
Yet too many children and families in Coventry are facing the challenges of poverty, impacting their health, education and future opportunities.

title: Record-breaking impact as Coventry’s visitor economy hits £1 billion
summary: Coventry’s visitor economy has smashed through the £1 billion mark for the first time.

title: City’s ‘outstanding’ work with children and young people recognised with visit by Ofsted Chief Inspector
summary: Sir Martyn Oliver, His Majesty's Chief Inspector at the Office for Standards in Education, Children's Services and Skills, visited Coventry to learn more about the city’s work with children.

title: Ganesh Puja celebrated in Coventry
summary: Coventry’s Hindu community came together on Monday 14 September for Shree Ganesh Mahotsav 2026, a community celebration organised by Shree Varashidhi Vinayaka Friend’s Circle.

title: Joint inspections on illegal Houses in Multiple Occupation (HMOs)
summary: The Council’s HMO Enforcement Team (along with partner agencies) regularly carry out targeted enforcement visits across the city.

title: Heritage Open Days 2026
summary: Heritage Open Days are returning to Coventry, as the city's historical and cultural venues open their doors for people to visit - completely free of charge.
